title: $7 a day could become $661,889
caption:
$7 a day is $2,555 a year.
Invested at 8% a year for 40 years, that grows to about $661,889.
Small daily habits, huge totals.
comment: What do you spend $7 a day on? 👇
sources: Math: $2,555 a year (7 × 365) at 8% for 40 years, end-of-year deposits: 2,555 × ((1.08^40 − 1) / 0.08) = 661,889

scenes.say: invested at eight percent for forty years,
grows to about six hundred and sixty-two thousand dollars.
So think twice before you spend
